fullPassage:
Seyun rides his bike to school every day. He likes his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year. His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it and add the money to buy a new one."

He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market: "Used bike in excellent condition. Only 100,000 won. Please text me." He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike. He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post down the list. His heart began to sink.

"What's wrong with my posting? Is my bike not attractive enough?" He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike. He added more photos to show his bike from different angles. "Twenty-four inch bicycle. Excellent condition. Always kept indoors. Rides just like new. Very few scratches. Good for someone 12-14 years old. 80,000 won."

This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a lower price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike. He felt both happy and sad. He was sad to see his old bike go, but he was happy with himself because he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience.

questions.passage: His bike has become too (A)[large / small] for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his (B)[savings / shopping] account. Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it and (C)[subtract / add] the money to buy a new one."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 자전거가 너무 작아져서(small) 더 큰 것을 원하고, 예금 계좌(savings account)에 돈이 부족하며, 자전거를 판 돈을 새것 살 돈에 보탤(add) 수 있다는 내용.
det.analysis:
✅ ① small — savings — add : 자전거가 '작아져서' 더 큰 걸 원하고, '예금' 계좌에 돈이 부족하며, 돈을 '보탤' 수 있다로 모두 문맥에 맞음.
❌ ② large — savings — subtract : large(큰)는 '작아졌다'와 반대, subtract(빼다)는 '보태다'와 반대.
❌ ③ small — shopping — subtract : shopping account는 어색하고 subtract도 틀림.
❌ ④ large — shopping — add : large, shopping 둘 다 문맥과 안 맞음.
det.tip: savings account = 예금 계좌, add the money = 돈을 보태다.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too (A)[patient / hasty] and too greedy. He had not given (B)[enough / little] information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too (C)[low / high].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 자신이 너무 성급하고(hasty) 욕심이 많았으며, 구매자에게 충분한(enough) 정보를 주지 않았고, 다른 자전거와 비교해 가격이 너무 높았음(high)을 깨달았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② hasty — enough — high : '성급했고', '충분한' 정보를 안 줬으며, 가격이 '높았다'로 모두 문맥에 맞음.
❌ ① hasty — enough — low : low(낮은)는 '가격이 너무 높아 안 팔렸다'는 흐름과 반대.
❌ ③ patient — little — high : patient(인내심 있는)는 greedy와 어울리지 않고, little도 어색.
❌ ④ patient — enough — low : patient, low 둘 다 문맥과 반대.
det.tip: hasty = 성급한, not give enough information = 충분한 정보를 주지 않다, price too high = 가격이 너무 높은.

questions.passage: He could not wait to get a (A)[reply / question] to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his expectations went (B)[up / down] too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike. His heart began to (C)[rise / sink].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 광고에 대한 답장(reply)을 몹시 기다렸고, 조회 수가 올라가자 기대도 올라갔지만(up), 아무도 사려 하지 않자 마음이 가라앉기(sink) 시작했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ reply — up — sink : 광고에 대한 '답장'을 기다리고, 기대가 '올라가며', 안 팔리자 마음이 '가라앉다'로 모두 문맥에 맞음.
❌ ① question — up — sink : question(질문)은 광고에 대한 반응으로 어색.
❌ ② reply — down — rise : down(내려가다)은 '기대가 올라갔다'와 반대, rise(오르다)도 틀림.
❌ ④ question — down — rise : 셋 다 문맥과 반대.
det.tip: get a reply = 답장을 받다, go up = 올라가다, heart sinks = 마음이 가라앉다.

questions.passage: His bike has become too ①<u>small</u> for him, so he wants to buy a ②<u>bigger</u>, faster one. However, he does not have ③<u>enough</u> money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost as good as a new one. Maybe I can sell it and ④<u>subtract</u> the money to buy a new one."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 자전거가 작아져서(small) 더 큰 것(bigger)을 원하고 돈이 충분치(enough) 않다. 판 돈을 새 자전거 살 돈에 '보태야(add)' 하므로 subtract(빼다)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ subtract(빼다)가 부적절 — 자전거를 판 돈을 새것 살 돈에 '보태다(add)'라고 해야 한다.
❌ ① small(작은) : 자전거가 작아졌다로 적절.
❌ ② bigger(더 큰) : 더 큰 자전거를 원함으로 적절.
❌ ③ enough(충분한) : 돈이 충분치 않다로 적절.
det.tip: add the money = 돈을 보태다 ↔ subtract = 빼다.

questions.passage: As the number of hits went up, his expectations went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a ①<u>whole</u> day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to ②<u>want</u> his bike. New postings by other people pushed his post ③<u>up</u> the list. His heart began to ④<u>sink</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 다른 사람들의 새 게시물이 세윤이의 글을 목록 '아래로(down)' 밀어 내렸다. up(위로)은 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ up(위로)이 부적절 — 새 게시물이 세윤이의 글을 목록 '아래로(down)' 밀어 내렸다고 해야 한다.
❌ ① whole(전체의) : 하루 종일이라는 뜻으로 적절.
❌ ② want(원하다) : 아무도 사고 싶어 하지 않았다로 적절.
❌ ④ sink(가라앉다) : 마음이 가라앉기 시작했다로 적절.
det.tip: push down = 아래로 밀어 내리다 ↔ push up.

questions.passage: It was hard to ①<u>accept</u> at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, ②<u>handed</u> over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike. He felt both happy and sad. He was ③<u>sad</u> to see his old bike go, but he was ④<u>unhappy</u> with himself because he had learned a lot and grown up a bit through the experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 많은 것을 배우고 조금 성장했기 때문에 자기 자신에게 '만족스러워했다(happy)'. unhappy(불만스러운)는 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ unhappy(불만스러운)가 부적절 — 많이 배우고 성장했으므로 자신에게 '만족스러워했다(happy)'가 맞다.
❌ ① accept(받아들이다) : 낮은 가격을 받아들이기 힘들었다로 적절.
❌ ② handed(건넸다) : 자전거를 건네주었다로 적절.
❌ ③ sad(슬픈) : 오래된 자전거를 보내며 슬펐다로 적절.
det.tip: be happy with oneself = 자신에게 만족하다 ↔ unhappy.

questions.passage: He acted fast. He took a photo of his bike with his smartphone and posted the picture, with a short comment, on an online market: "Used bike in excellent __________. Only 100,000 won. Please text me." He was excited, thinking about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '아주 좋은 상태(excellent condition)의 중고 자전거'라는 광고 문구이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① condition(상태) : 'in excellent condition(아주 좋은 상태의)'은 중고품을 광고할 때 쓰는 표현으로 적절.
❌ ② position(위치) : 물건 상태를 뜻하지 못함.
❌ ③ direction(방향) : 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ question(질문) : 문맥 무관.
det.tip: in excellent condition = 아주 좋은 상태인.

questions.passage: He could not wait to get a reply to his online advertisement. Every few minutes he checked the number of hits. As the number of hits went up, his __________ went up too. One hour passed, then two, and finally a whole day, but he received no texts. Nobody seemed to want his bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 조회 수가 올라가자 세윤이의 '기대(expectations)'도 함께 올라갔다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② expectations(기대) : 조회 수가 오를수록 팔릴 거라는 '기대'가 커지는 흐름에 맞음.
❌ ① problems(문제) : 긍정적 흐름과 반대.
❌ ③ worries(걱정) : 기대가 아니라 걱정은 문맥과 어긋남.
❌ ④ prices(가격) : 조회 수와 함께 오르는 대상으로 어색.
det.tip: expectations go up = 기대가 커지다.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough __________ to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 잠재적 구매자에게 충분한 '정보(information)'를 주지 않았음을 깨달았다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① information(정보) : 짧은 설명만 올려 구매자에게 '정보'를 충분히 주지 못했다는 흐름에 맞음.
❌ ② money(돈) : 구매자에게 주는 대상으로 어색.
❌ ③ time(시간) : 문맥 무관.
❌ ④ space(공간) : 문맥 무관.
det.tip: give information to buyers = 구매자에게 정보를 주다.

questions.passage: "What's wrong with my posting? Is my bike not <u>attractive</u> enough?" He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 attractive와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: attractive = 매력적인. appealing(마음을 끄는)과 뜻이 가장 가깝다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② appealing(마음을 끄는) : attractive와 의미가 같음.
❌ ① boring(지루한) : 반대 느낌.
❌ ③ ugly(못생긴) : 반대 뜻.
❌ ④ cheap(값싼) : 가격과 관련, 뜻이 다름.
det.tip: attractive ≒ appealing = 매력적인.

questions.passage: He searched on the Internet for tips on how to sell online. Then he <u>realized</u> what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 realized와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: realized = 깨달았다. understood(이해했다, 알아차렸다)와 뜻이 가장 가깝다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① understood(알아차렸다) : realized와 의미가 같음.
❌ ② forgot(잊었다) : 반대 뜻.
❌ ③ ignored(무시했다) : 뜻이 다름.
❌ ④ doubted(의심했다) : 뜻이 다름.
det.tip: realize ≒ understand = 깨닫다, 알아차리다.

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too <u>hasty</u> and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 hasty와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: hasty = 성급한, 서두르는. hurried(서두르는)와 뜻이 가장 가깝다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② hurried(서두르는) : hasty와 의미가 같음.
❌ ① careful(신중한) : 반대 뜻.
❌ ③ lazy(게으른) : 뜻이 다름.
❌ ④ honest(정직한) : 뜻이 다름.
det.tip: hasty ≒ hurried = 성급한.

questions.passage: This time he got several texts. Sadly, they all asked for a <u>lower</u> price. It was hard to accept at first, but finally he sold his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed. Now he could get a new bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 lower와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: lower = 더 낮은. 그 반대말은 higher(더 높은)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② higher(더 높은) : lower(더 낮은)의 반대말.
❌ ① cheaper(더 싼) : 값이 낮다는 뜻이라 오히려 lower와 비슷.
❌ ③ smaller(더 작은) : 크기 관련이라 반대말 아님.
❌ ④ weaker(더 약한) : 힘 관련이라 반대말 아님.
det.tip: lower ↔ higher = 더 낮은 ↔ 더 높은.

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too <u>greedy</u>. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when compared to other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 greedy와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: greedy = 욕심 많은. 그 반대말은 generous(너그러운, 베푸는)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ generous(너그러운) : greedy(욕심 많은)의 반대말.
❌ ① selfish(이기적인) : greedy와 비슷한 뜻이라 반대말 아님.
❌ ② hungry(배고픈) : 식욕과 관련, 반대말 아님.
❌ ③ honest(정직한) : 뜻이 다름.
det.tip: greedy ↔ generous = 욕심 많은 ↔ 너그러운.

questions.passage:
(A) He <u>likes</u> his bike, but he is taller and stronger this year.

(B) Excellent condition. Always kept indoors. Rides just <u>like</u> new.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 like의 의미로 바르게 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) He likes his bike = 그는 자전거를 '좋아한다' → 동사. (B) Rides just like new = 새것'처럼' 잘 나간다 → 전치사.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 좋아하다 — (B) ~처럼 : (A)는 '좋아하다'라는 동사, (B)는 '~처럼'이라는 전치사.
❌ ① ~처럼 — ~처럼 : (A)가 틀림.
❌ ② 좋아하다 — 좋아하다 : (B)가 틀림.
❌ ④ ~처럼 — 좋아하다 : 둘 다 반대.
det.tip: like = ①좋아하다(동사) ②~처럼(전치사). just like new = 새것처럼.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "pleasant or appealing to look at or think about"

det.korean: 정의: 보거나 생각하기에 기분 좋고 마음을 끄는 → attractive(매력적인).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ attractive(매력적인) : '보기 좋고 마음을 끄는'이라는 정의와 일치.
❌ ① hasty(성급한) : 정의와 무관.
❌ ② greedy(욕심 많은) : 정의와 무관.
❌ ③ lower(더 낮은) : 정의와 무관.
det.tip: attractive = 매력적인, 마음을 끄는.

questions.passage: He was excited, __________ (think) about the bike he planned to buy. He could see himself riding the shiny new bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: He was excited, thinking about ~ = 그는 신이 나서 ~을 생각했다. 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문이다.
det.analysis: 앞 문장(He was excited)에 동시에 일어나는 동작을 덧붙이는 분사구문 자리입니다. '~하면서'의 뜻으로 동사원형 think에 -ing를 붙여 thinking으로 씁니다. (He was excited, thinking about ~)
det.tip: 분사구문: 동사 + -ing = ~하면서.

questions.passage: It was hard to accept at first, but finally he __________ (sell) his bike for 70,000 won. He met the buyer, handed over his bike, and got the money he needed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: finally he sold his bike = 마침내 그는 자전거를 '팔았다'. 이미 일어난 과거의 일이므로 과거형이다.
det.analysis: 뒤의 met, handed, got처럼 모두 과거시제로 이야기가 전개되므로 과거형이 필요합니다. sell은 불규칙 동사로 sell-sold-sold이므로 과거형은 sold입니다.
det.tip: sell-sold-sold (불규칙 동사). 과거형 = sold.

questions.passage: His bike has become too small for him, so he wants to buy a bigger, faster one. However, he does not have enough money in his savings account. What can he do? Suddenly, Seyun had an idea. "My old bike is almost __________ a new one. Maybe I can sell it and add the money to buy a new one."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세윤이는 자기 헌 자전거가 거의 '새것만큼 좋다(as good as a new one)'고 생각한다. 그래서 팔아서 돈을 보태려 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① as good as(~만큼 좋은) : 헌 자전거를 팔려고 '거의 새것만큼 좋다'고 말하는 흐름에 맞음.
❌ ② far from(~와는 거리가 먼) : 상태가 좋다는 흐름과 반대.
❌ ③ better than(~보다 나은) : '새것보다 낫다'는 과장이라 almost와 어울리지 않음.
❌ ④ worse than(~보다 못한) : 팔려는 의도와 반대.
det.tip: as good as = ~만큼 좋은 (원급 비교).

questions.passage: Then he realized what he had done wrong. He had been too hasty and too greedy. He had not given enough information to the possible buyers. Also, when __________ other bicycles, his price was too high. He wrote a new posting with a longer description of the bike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 다른 자전거들과 '비교했을 때(compared to)' 세윤이의 가격이 너무 높았다는 뜻이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ compared to(~와 비교하여) : 다른 자전거들과 '비교해 보니' 가격이 높았다는 흐름에 맞음.
❌ ① instead of(~대신에) : 비교의 뜻이 없음.
❌ ② apart from(~은 제외하고) : 문맥과 맞지 않음.
❌ ④ close to(~에 가까운) : 비교 표현이 아님.
det.tip: compared to = ~와 비교하여.
